latestVersion.changelog:
UK Employee Handbook & Policy Generator, initial release:

- Generates tailored, legally compliant UK employee handbooks and workplace policies based on business type, size, and working arrangements.
- Adapts coverage, depth, and governance by company headcount (micro, small, medium, large business tiers).
- Gathers key business details with up to 4 clarifying questions if needed.
- Cites current legislation (including ERA 2025, Working Time, and recent flexible working law).
- Output is a structured, ready-to-implement handbook (with version control, table of contents, all required policy sections, and solicitor review disclaimer).
- Covers essential HR policies: employment terms, working hours, leave, sickness, family leave, and more.
